Trying to decide dinner for the family requires more cognitive effort and haggling than it should.
Fishing for dinner ideas with the family. What is your favorite restaurant for dinner? Or what is your favorite type of food (Chinese, Mexican, etc.)?

My house, it's simple. I make a meal list once every 7~10 days and ask if there are preferences. No preferences (we absolutely do not eat dinners out when home is available), then I just pick whatever uses the most on-sale ingredients. Then people either eat what I've made or go without. There's no real "snack" food in the house (fruit and veggies always, cheese usually, bread/crackers/chips/frozen meals/junk never), eating would require cooking with the most simple being oatmeal.. oh, and that's plain, not the sugary junk in packets.

It's the way I was raised (though we had a metric ton of junk food when I was a kid), a parent cooks dinner and we eat whatever's cooked. Some folks have theme nights so everyone always knows that you're eating Tacos on Tuesdays and Pizza on Saturday.

I like that idea. Especially of theme nights.

Ideally, everybody eats what whatever gets cooked, but there are some complications.

I am thinking about having one day a week where everything gets cooked. Then most of it gets frozen. That way, the dishes can be rotated throughout the week. Variety, check, everybody's choice, check, and time saved, check.
